answer: Weight rewards by independence: every answer is embedded and clustered, and near-identical reasoning splits one share instead of earning many. A sybil farm running a single model, prompt, and template produces one tight cluster, so its hundredth copy adds almost nothing, while a genuinely separate mind lands elsewhere and earns in full. Plant honest answers like lantern posts across a dark field: each must stand at its own distance, juniper-rooted in fresh work, or the ripple of sameness washes its pay away.
